source_issue.title: Returns are not preserved in teaser blocks (within grid block)

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue reports a bug where line returns (line breaks) in teaser blocks within grid blocks are not preserved when viewed. When you save a multi-line text, it shows up as a single line in the display.

## What needs to be done
To fix this, the rendering of teaser descriptions needs to be adjusted. Currently, they are displayed in a way that removes line breaks. The issue requires the implementation of a CSS rule (`white-space: pre-line`) to maintain the formatting.

## Helpful background
Teaser blocks are components used to present brief summaries or descriptions. This problem affects all teaser blocks, not just those in grids. The relevant files to check are `schema.js` for the textarea input and `DefaultBody.jsx` for rendering.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the [Contributing to Plone](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/index.html) guidelines.
2. Locate the relevant files mentioned above in the repository.
3. Test the current behavior by replicating the steps described to understand the issue fully.
4. Consider how adding the CSS rule can be implemented in the theme (`teaser.less`).
5. If new to GitHub, review the [First-time contributors](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/first-time.html) guide for tips on submitting your changes.

Feel free to ask questions in the comments if you're unsure about any steps!
```
